deadline.value: Applications are accepted all year round with no cut-off date, but scholarship closing dates are strict.
deadline.quote: Applications for admission to UNSW as a graduate student are accepted all year round | There are no cut-off dates for students applying for entry to research degrees (MSc or PhD)

entry_route.value: The school's normal PhD entry is an honours degree with a good honours mark, or comparable Masters performance.
entry_route.quote: The normal requirement for admission to a PhD program is an honours degree with a good Honours mark (or comparable performance in a Masters degree)

supervisor.value: The school recommends contacting a potential supervisor before you apply.
supervisor.quote: We recommend that you find a potential supervisor at the School before submitting your application

funding.value: Scholarships for international students are awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: A number of scholarships are offered to international students on a competitive basis

toefl_min.value: Science research degrees need TOEFL iBT 90 overall, with at least 23 in writing and 22 in the other sections.
toefl_min.quote: 90 overall (min. 23 in writing, 22 in reading, listening and speaking)

ielts_min.value: Science research degrees need IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with at least 6.0 in each band.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the pages checked.

notes: The school's PhD route covers mathematics and statistics. Tuition for international students is substantial unless an IPRS, UIPA or TFS scholarship covers it.
